name: net_component_53_empty
description: The network manager (class 0xC990BD46; QueryInterface 1, 0xA9764C8C, 0x452294AA, 0xE4FDA3D4) writes an empty managed list as u16 1 + u32 0. A record of version 2 reads false after the version (2 bytes); a stream already in error reads nothing. A null reference reads as a null entry (question NM6); a reference that does not resolve fails the read at once, keeping the entries appended so far.

steps.note: null, then 0x0A, then 0x63 which is no occupant
